package student

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"reflect"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
)

type planningSnapshotReaderStub struct {
	source            domain.PlanningSnapshotSource
	err               error
	calls             int
	studentID, pathID string
	targets           []domain.LearningTargetRef
}

func (s *planningSnapshotReaderStub) ReadPlanningSnapshot(_ context.Context, sid, pid string, targets []domain.LearningTargetRef) (domain.PlanningSnapshotSource, error) {
	s.calls++
	s.studentID = sid
	s.pathID = pid
	s.targets = append([]domain.LearningTargetRef(nil), targets...)
	return s.source, s.err
}
func snapshotUseCaseFixture() (*planningSnapshotReaderStub, domain.PlanningSnapshotRequest) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 10, 5, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	sid := "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
	pid := "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
	targets := []domain.LearningTargetRef{{Type: domain.LearningTargetConcept, Key: "go.versioned", Version: "v1"}, {Type: domain.LearningTargetConcept, Key: "legacy.opaque"}}
	s := &planningSnapshotReaderStub{source: domain.PlanningSnapshotSource{StudentID: sid, RequestedTargets: targets, CapturedAt: now,
		Profile: domain.StudentOnboarding{StudentID: sid, DirectionCode: "backend", SelfAssessedExperience: "basic", DesiredStacks: []string{"go"}, GoalCode: "first-job", PreferredLanguage: "ru", WeeklyMinutes: 300, PreferredPace: "balanced", ProfileVersion: domain.StudentOnboardingProfileVersion, Version: 1, CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now},
		Path:    domain.StudentLearningPath{ID: pid, StudentID: sid, CourseID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", GoalCode: "go.backend", CurriculumRevision: "course-fingerprint", PolicyVersion: domain.LearningPathPolicyVersion, PlannerPolicyVersion: "planner-v1", ReasonCode: "initial_plan", ReasonSummary: "Private historical reason", Status: domain.LearningPathStatusActive, Version: 3, CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now, Items: []domain.LearningPathItem{{ID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555", Position: 0, Status: domain.LearningPathItemReady, ReasonCode: "first_gap", Targets: targets}}},
		Context: domain.StudentLearningContext{Schema: domain.LearningContextSchemaVersion, StudentID: sid, SelectedLearningPathID: pid, Version: 4, UpdatedAt: &now},
	}}
	return s, domain.PlanningSnapshotRequest{Targets: targets, TriggerContext: domain.PlanningSnapshotTrigger{Kind: "manual", Reason: "caller request"}}
}
func TestGetPlanningSnapshotMakesOneExactOwnerReadAndCompletesMissingProjection(t *testing.T) {
	reader, request := snapshotUseCaseFixture()
	u := GetPlanningSnapshot{Reader: reader}
	result, err := u.Handle(context.Background(), reader.source.StudentID, reader.source.Path.ID, request)
	if err != nil || reader.calls != 1 || reader.studentID != reader.source.StudentID || reader.pathID != reader.source.Path.ID {
		t.Fatalf("owner read: err=%v reader=%#v", err, reader)
	}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(reader.targets, result.RequestedTargets) || len(result.Mastery) != 2 || result.Mastery[0].State != domain.TargetMasteryUnknown || result.Mastery[1].Target.Version != "" || result.Mastery[1].EvidenceCount != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("missing projections/legacy identity changed: %#v", result.Mastery)
	}
	if result.Availability.EvidenceQuality.Value != nil || result.Availability.Stability.Value != nil || result.Availability.AutomaticAdaptation.Value != nil {
		t.Fatal("unsupported semantics were fabricated")
	}
	if result.References.SnapshotRef == "" || result.References.GoalRef == "" || result.References.ConstraintsRef == "" {
		t.Fatal("missing applicability refs")
	}
}
func TestGetPlanningSnapshotRejectsCallerInputBeforeRepositoryRead(t *testing.T) {
	for _, name := range []string{"student", "path", "empty_targets", "duplicate_targets", "trace", "correlation"} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			reader, request := snapshotUseCaseFixture()
			sid, pid := reader.source.StudentID, reader.source.Path.ID
			switch name {
			case "student":
				sid = "bad"
			case "path":
				pid = "bad"
			case "empty_targets":
				request.Targets = nil
			case "duplicate_targets":
				request.Targets = append(request.Targets, request.Targets[0])
			case "trace":
				request.TriggerContext.Reason = " "
			case "correlation":
				request.TriggerContext.CorrelationID = "not-uuid"
			}
			if _, err := (GetPlanningSnapshot{Reader: reader}).Handle(context.Background(), sid, pid, request); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) || reader.calls != 0 {
				t.Fatalf("invalid caller read owner: err=%v calls=%d", err, reader.calls)
			}
		})
	}
}
func TestGetPlanningSnapshotRejectsForeignIncompleteAndMalformedOwnerObservation(t *testing.T) {
	for _, name := range []string{"student", "path", "profile", "request_set", "capture"} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			reader, request := snapshotUseCaseFixture()
			sid, pid := reader.source.StudentID, reader.source.Path.ID
			switch name {
			case "student":
				reader.source.StudentID = "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa"
			case "path":
				reader.source.Path.ID = "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa"
			case "profile":
				reader.source.Profile.StudentID = "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa"
			case "request_set":
				reader.source.RequestedTargets = reader.source.RequestedTargets[:1]
			case "capture":
				reader.source.CapturedAt = time.Time{}
			}
			if _, err := (GetPlanningSnapshot{Reader: reader}).Handle(context.Background(), sid, pid, request); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrPlanningSnapshotSourceInvalid) || reader.calls != 1 {
				t.Fatalf("owner source repaired/accepted: err=%v calls=%d", err, reader.calls)
			}
		})
	}
}
func TestGetPlanningSnapshotPropagatesOwnerAvailabilityWithoutFallbackOrWrite(t *testing.T) {
	for _, cause := range []error{domain.ErrNotFound, domain.ErrConflict, context.Canceled, errors.New("read transaction unavailable"), domain.ErrValidation} {
		reader, request := snapshotUseCaseFixture()
		reader.err = cause
		_, err := (GetPlanningSnapshot{Reader: reader}).Handle(context.Background(), reader.source.StudentID, reader.source.Path.ID, request)
		expected := cause
		if errors.Is(cause, domain.ErrValidation) {
			expected = domain.ErrPlanningSnapshotSourceInvalid
		}
		if !errors.Is(err, expected) || reader.calls != 1 {
			t.Fatalf("availability lost or retried: cause=%v err=%v calls=%d", cause, err, reader.calls)
		}
	}
}
